name: Altura
summary: A dark investment dashboard with a morphing hero chart you can scrub, in graphite and gold
about: A calm, one-screen investment dashboard for wealth and investing apps, in graphite and champagne gold with an ivory light theme. Pick a time range and the main chart morphs to it, drag across it to read any day, and compare against an index. Extra pages cover holdings with a buy and sell drawer, performance, allocation with a one-click rebalance, a watchlist with alerts and settings.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Overview, Holdings, Performance, Allocation, Watchlist or Settings
Switch 1W to 5Y and watch the main chart morph; drag or hover across it to read past values
Toggle Compare with index to draw the benchmark line
Click a holding to open its drawer, then buy or sell units with your cash
On Allocation, edit target percentages and press Rebalance now
Add watchlist ideas and price alerts, press Ctrl+K to jump, and reset demo data in Settings
